story.en: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha says: "We need top earning drivers per city for bonus distribution."
story.ta: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Sneha sollraanga: "City-ku top earning drivers venum — bonus kudukanum."
story.hi: Uber HQ, Friday shaam. Sneha bolti hai: "Har city ke top earning drivers chahiye — bonus dena hai."
story.te: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Sneha cheppindi: "City-wise top earning drivers kavali — bonus ivvali."

question.en: Find total earnings of each driver and show top 3 earning drivers per city.
question.ta: Oru driver total evlo earn pannirukkaan nu calculate panni, city-ku top 3 drivers kaatu.
question.hi: Har driver ka total earning nikalo aur har city ke top 3 drivers dikhao.
question.te: Prathi driver total earnings calculate chesi, prathi city lo top 3 drivers chupinchu.

title.hi: Drivers aur trips ko join karte hain
title.te: Drivers mariyu trips ni join cheddam

steps.sql:
SELECT d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city, t.fare
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t
  ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id;

en: SELECT chooses which columns to display.
d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city → taken from drivers table.
FROM drivers d → base table, 'd' is alias.
JOIN trips t → second table, 't' is alias.
Only rows where driver_id matches in both tables will appear.
ta: SELECT → endha columns display panna venum nu sollum.
d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city → drivers table-lendhu varudhu.
FROM drivers d → main table, 'd' nu short name kuduthom.
JOIN trips t → innum oru table join pannrom.
ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id → rendu table connect aagum condition.
Match aana rows dhaan result-la varum.
hi: SELECT decide karta hai kaunse columns dikhane hain.
d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city → drivers table se.
FROM drivers d → main table hai.
JOIN trips t → dusri table connect kar rahe hain.
ON condition → dono tables ka connection rule hai.
Sirf matching rows hi result mein aayengi.
te: SELECT → ye columns chupinchalo ani decide chestundi.
d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city → drivers table nundi.
JOIN trips t → second table join chestunnam.
ON condition → rendu tables ela connect avvalo cheptundi.
Match aina rows maatrame result lo vastayi.

steps.sql:
SELECT d.driver_id,
       d.driver_name,
       d.city,
       SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t
  ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city;

en: SUM(t.fare) → adds all fares for a driver.
AS total_earnings → gives a name to the result column.
GROUP BY → groups rows based on driver.
Each driver will have one row after grouping.
Without GROUP BY, SUM will calculate for entire table.
ta: SUM(t.fare) → oru driver oda ella trip fare-um add pannum.
AS total_earnings → result-ku oru column name kudukkrom.
Oru driver-ku oru row dhaan varum.
GROUP BY illa-na full table-ku oru sum dhaan varum.
hi: SUM(t.fare) → ek driver ke saare fares add karta hai.
AS total_earnings → column ka naam set karta hai.
GROUP BY → driver ke hisaab se grouping hoti hai.
Har driver ka ek hi row aayega.
GROUP BY nahi hoga toh poora table ka sum aayega.
te: SUM(t.fare) → oka driver ki anni fares kalipi total isthundi.
AS total_earnings → column ki name ivvadam.
Prathi driver ki oka row vastundi.
GROUP BY lekunda full table ki okate sum vastundi.

title.hi: Har city ke top 3 drivers nikalte hain
title.te: Prathi city lo top 3 drivers kanukundam

steps.sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT d.driver_id,
         d.driver_name,
         d.city,
         SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.city ORDER BY SUM(t.fare) DESC) AS rn
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN trips t
    ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3;

en: PARTITION BY d.city → resets ranking for each city.
ORDER BY SUM(t.fare) DESC → highest earning first.
Subquery → used to apply ranking first.
WHERE rn <= 3 → picks top 3 drivers per city.
ta: PARTITION BY city → ovvoru city-kum separate ranking.
ORDER BY earnings DESC → highest first varum.
WHERE rn <= 3 → top 3 drivers mattum edukkrom.
hi: PARTITION BY city → har city ke liye alag ranking.
ORDER BY DESC → highest earning pehle.
Subquery → pehle ranking calculate karte hain.
WHERE rn <= 3 → top 3 drivers select karte hain.
te: PARTITION BY city → prathi city ki separate ranking.
ORDER BY DESC → highest earning mundu.
WHERE rn <= 3 → top 3 drivers select chestam.
